name: IEC mechanical position-switch contact: bi-directional lever actuated - normally closed
aliases: mechanical position-switch contact Bi-directional Lever Actuated - Normally Closed
summary: Mechanical position-switch contact form: Bi-directional Lever Actuated - Normally Closed.
description: A mechanically operated position switch changes its contact state when travel, a cam or a lever reaches the documented operating condition. The actuator mark explains how movement reaches the switch; the electrical contact still has to be read in its stated unoperated position. This entry identifies the bi-directional lever actuated - normally closed form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A moving carriage may operate the switch near the end of travel, or an operator may move a multidirectional lever. Identify the actual direction or target position on the drawing and connect the switch tag to the corresponding mechanical detail. The normally-closed designation starts with a conducting output or closed contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. Two operating directions are represented. Identify the direction-to-contact mapping in the mechanical detail rather than assuming one signal applies to every movement.

Detents retain an operating position and are different from a spring-return mechanism. The schematic does not supply operating travel, overtravel, contact force or a safety performance level; use the selected switch data for those properties.
